name: anew-dreams
description: Lumi Moonbolt, Junior Space-Car Engineer. A MERN storybook website with Three.js, GSAP and Framer Motion.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
